note: Vanilla Olden Era adventure-map effect subtrees reused on HoMM3 map-building meshes (lane vanilla_style_effect). Each preset clones one bare ParticleSystem subtree of a native map-object prefab; keepNodes are the systems left emitting (all magic/VfxUber, which does its own fog-of-war discard). nativeWorldRotation is the childPath's world rotation inside its own prefab with the prefab root excluded (Unity xyzw, static read); the anchor empty bakes it so the clone keeps its native orientation. scale is the default world size in unscaled model (Meshy GLB) units; rows override it. anchorNode (optional) is the kept node that lands on the anchor (the fountain systems sit ~0.5 native units above their subtree root).

fire.note: native campfire flames, sparks and a little smoke; Fire_01 (the flame base, 0.24 native units below the subtree root) lands on the anchor

lava.note: native map fire without its ground crack (non-VfxUber shader): embers, low flames and a warm ground flash for molten beds and pools

vortex.note: altar of magic ball: turning vortex, energy wisps and flicks

fountain.note: native fountain jets and the ring wave on the basin

ripple.note: fountain ring wave alone: water surface ripple

splash.note: fountain spray droplets alone (pair with ripple where a fall meets its pool)

candle.note: altar of magic candle: a small flame (the cloned root) and its warm glow (Global_glow_04, alpha 0.88), flickering; used for lit windows, doors, vents and hollows. flash_big is a dim violet swell whose luminance-kept recolour stays too faint to read on a facade.
